# Xbox 360

Every app in this list that runs on Xbox 360. That is 3 apps with 2 for Plex and 1 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Butter and Jelly](https://github.com/MrMilenko/ButterAndJelly) - App for classic game consoles. `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `Xbox 360` `Original Xbox` `Wii U` · `GPL-2.0` `Free`
- [multiplex360](https://github.com/HG-ERIK/multiplex360) - Homebrew client for modded Xbox 360 consoles. `Plex` · `Xbox 360` · `GPL-3.0`
- [plex360](https://github.com/shinzarou-eng/plex360) - Native Plex client for jailbroken Xbox 360 consoles. `Plex` · `Xbox 360` · `Open source` `Beta`
